projects.name: Carnage: Death Metal
projects.desc: A landscape, touch-controlled fighting game with a death-metal guitar theme, playable right in the browser.
projects.long: Carnage: Death Metal is a fullscreen browser game made for phones held sideways. It features touch controls for dashing, strumming and attacking, a super move, and a five-string guitar HUD (E A D G C).

projects.name: KatMusic
projects.desc: A YouTube Music player for Android, Windows, macOS and Linux with Listen Together, synced lyrics, offline downloads and shareable KatMusic Codes.
projects.long: KatMusic is a free, open-source music player with word-synced lyrics, a native C++ audio engine with parametric EQ, Listen Together rooms with QR invites, offline downloads and two interface styles, Classic and Modern. The Android app is built in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, and the desktop apps use Flutter. An Arct Development project.
